name: Muskogee County, OK
findings: Muskogee County has 168 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Muskogee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.
